modInfo: This module creates a scrap car yard in Cell 29x30 on the world map, with a three-story building in the middle: the first floor is the auto repair warehouse and material storage area. The second floor is a warehouse. The third floor is a residential area, the outdoor platform on the third floor has land for planting, and the roof of the third floor can be used for rainwater collection. The module is still being improved, I hope you like it.
